exercises.title: BA backgrounds 1 — whose strength or gap?
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers: BAs come from different backgrounds, each with strengths and pitfalls. Name the background each statement describes.

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
BA đến từ nhiều xuất phát điểm khác nhau, mỗi loại có điểm mạnh và điểm yếu. Gọi tên xuất phát điểm.

Mỗi dòng được chấm riêng; giải thích từng đáp án hiện sau khi nộp.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

examplesJson.output: Correct / Incorrect + explanation after Submit|||Đúng / Sai + giải thích sau khi Nộp
examplesJson.explanation: Each question (or table cell) is one check.|||Mỗi câu (hoặc ô) là một kiểm.

hintsJson: Giỏi tìm ngoại lệ ⇒ từng là tester.
Biết "as-is" rõ nhưng khó hình dung "to-be" ⇒ chuyên gia nghiệp vụ.

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: Former user
   - r1.k: Former tester
   - r2.k: Subject-matter expert
   - r3.k: Former project manager
   - r4.k: Rookie
   - r5.k: Former developer
   Every path into the role works if the BA consciously fills its typical gap.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Every path into the role works if the BA consciously fills its typical gap.

bang.de:
Choose the right value for every row.

Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.

o.s: Speaks the users’ language and is trusted by former colleagues, but knows little about software engineering.
Thinks naturally about exceptions and how things break — great for finding gaps.
Knows the domain deeply but may specify to personal preferences and struggle to imagine the "to-be" system.
Strong at negotiation and organisation, but must shift focus from timelines and budget to business needs.
Has few preconceived notions; benefits most from mentoring.
Understands technical feasibility but may lack patience with users and domain knowledge.

bang.giaiThich: Every path into the role works if the BA consciously fills its typical gap.

mistakesJson.loi: Nhầm SME với người dùng cũ.
Nghĩ người mới (rookie) không có lợi thế nào.

exercises.title: BA backgrounds 2 — the SME risk and essential knowledge
exercises.problemHtml:
An SME hired as the analyst may specify to their own preferences rather than all user classes’ needs. Often better: a BA from the development team works with the SME as a key user representative or product champion. Essential BA knowledge: requirements practices across life cycles, when (and when not) to use each technique, project management, risk and quality, and enough domain knowledge to detect unstated assumptions.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Rủi ro khi SME làm BA; kiến thức thiết yếu của BA.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

Biết khi nào KHÔNG dùng một kỹ thuật cũng là kiến thức.

# BA backgrounds 2 — the SME risk and essential knowledge — answer key

   Answer: d) Pair a BA with the doctor, who acts as product champion; the BA also hears other user classes

exercises.title: BA backgrounds 3 — the BA on an agile team
exercises.problemHtml:
On agile projects the BA defines a lightweight, flexible requirements process; keeps documentation at the right level; decides how to document the backlog; facilitates frequent stakeholder conversations; validates that customer needs are in the backlog and helps prioritise it; and manages changing minds. Which statements fit an agile BA?

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Câu nào phù hợp với BA trong đội agile?

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: The role does not disappear on agile — its timing and documentation style change.

o.s: Keeps documentation "just enough" for developers and testers.
Writes a complete 200-page SRS before the first sprint.
